Wrote `/home/mara/cwe-bench/pipelines/stacking/out/screener-ds-rescreen/23736.json`.

- **Trust decision:** whether a request-supplied xsd:anyURI DSML value is fetched server-side is decided in `ByteStringUtility.convertValue`'s URI branch (`ByteStringUtility.java:55-66`), which at the pinned commit unconditionally calls `openStream()`; the fix moves it into `convertUri` behind a flag set from context-params in `DSMLServlet.init`, with `web.xml` separately deciding container auth.
- **pattern_fit:** `injection_only` — no Pattern A (single Maven module, fix lands on the sink) and no Pattern B (all five DSML operations funnel through that one branch, so one hardened site covers them all).
- **Strongest lever:** the producer — the XSD union plus `mapAnyUriToUri` turns a request value into `java.net.URI` in a layer `convertUri` never calls, and the adjacent legitimate behaviour (storing anyURI values verbatim when dereferencing is off) punishes over-broad rejection.
- **Biggest red flag:** none of the listed red flags holds; the real weakness is that this is a single centrally hardened sink, with resource-exhaustion being one of its three sub-issues (historically 0/7 for task hardness).
